title: Partner Utility Program Schedule: Co-Funding of Whole Water Service Line Replacement for Utility Line Protection Plans
content:
# Partner Utility Program Schedule: Co-Funding of Whole Water Service Line Replacement

Partner programs schedule for the Bridgewell Utility Line Protection Plans.

## Rule

Exterior partner co-funding: on a water service line that calls for whole-line work, a plan enrolled through Lakeshore Water Authority whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the exterior partner window adds the Lakeshore co-funding, and a plan enrolled through Riverbend Municipal Utilities whose premium has been remitted through that utility's bill within the exterior partner window adds the Riverbend co-funding; every other request adds no exterior partner co-funding. Exterior windows counted in months run back from the day the payment is booked: an entry falls within an exterior window when fewer whole months than the window separate its posting date from that day. The exterior partner co-funding is paid on top of the occurrence cap, and only for permanent exterior work whose contractor quote is above the exterior permanent-work payment.

An exterior line calls for whole-line work when the plan replaces whole lines after repeat breaks, which is when its full replacement break count is above zero, and the most recent completed repair on the same line was completed no more than the plan's replacement lookback days before the request date.

## Plan figures that decide whole-line work

| Plan | Full-replacement break count | Replacement lookback |
|---|---|---|
| Bridgewell Exterior Water Service Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Electrical Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Exterior Sewer and Septic Line Plan | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Interior Plumbing and Drainage Plan | 0 | 0 days |
| Bridgewell Water and Sewer Line Bundle | 2 | 730 days |
| Bridgewell Total Home Lines Plan | 2 | 730 days |

## Co-funding

| Water service line calling for whole-line work | Enrolled through | Utility-bill premium remittance within the 12-month exterior partner window | Co-funding |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | Lakeshore Water Authority | yes | $500.00 (Lakeshore) |
| yes | Riverbend Municipal Utilities | yes | $250.00 (Riverbend) |
| yes | either of these | no | none |
| yes | any other utility, or direct | either | none |
| no | any | either | none |

*Hypothetical window cases (payment booked 12 August 2026):* a utility-bill remittance posted 13 August 2025 is within the window; one posted 12 August 2025 is not.
